statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of presyncope and transient loss of consciousness
The patient requires evaluation for underlying rhythm disturbances
There is clinical suspicion of sick sinus syndrome
The patient has unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.5, I49.9)
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) is ordered
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204
The service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
